刺鼻的白酒味混着廉价烟草的味道窜进鼻孔，林川猛地睁开眼。

眼前是熟悉得刻进骨头里的小饭馆包厢。

墙上贴着2000年春晚的宣传海报，桌上的搪瓷缸子缺了个口，旁边摊着一份皱巴巴的《江城日报》。

日期赫然印着——2000年5月18日。

对面坐着的两个人，正凑在他面前笑，笑容虚伪得让林川胃里翻江倒海。

左边是他的老婆刘梅，穿着洗得发白的粉色衬衫，头发烫成时下流行的大波浪，眼里却满是算计。

“林川，你快签啊，签了这份股权转让协议，我们就能拿到10万块钱还债，以后就能过好日子了。”

右边是他从小到大的发小张磊，穿着假的皮尔卡丹西装，手腕上戴着块晃眼的假劳力士，递笔的手都在抖。

“是啊川子，你爸年纪大了，机械厂早就经营不下去了，卖给我爸，你们家还能拿到10万块钱还债，不然银行就要来封你们家房子了。”

股权转让协议。

2000年5月18日。

林川浑身的血瞬间冲到头顶，指甲攥得掌心渗血都没察觉。

他不是冻死在2023年冬天的桥洞下了吗？

前世的今天——他被这两个人合谋灌了一斤白酒，稀里糊涂签了父亲经营一辈子的机械厂股权转让协议。

整座厂，只卖了10万块钱。

后来张磊父子拿着股权等来拆迁，赔了整整8000万。

张磊住别墅、开公司，成了江城有头有脸的老板，还娶了刘梅。

而他林家呢？

父亲被活活气死，母亲哭瞎了眼，妹妹为了还债辍学打工，下班路上被酒驾的车撞了。

他自己在桥洞下冻得连手指都蜷不起来，最后闭上眼睛的那一刻，满脑子只有一个念头——要是那天没签字就好了。

没想到，老天真给了他这个机会。

“川子，你愣着干嘛啊？快签啊！”

刘梅见他不动，伸手就要拉他的手按在协议上，语气里满是不耐烦。

张磊也笑着哄他：“签完我们去吃涮羊肉，我请客，管够。”

看着这两张脸，林川只觉得一股腥气从喉咙底翻上来。

他猛地抬手，一把抄起桌上剩下的半杯白酒，劈头盖脸泼了过去！

“我签你妈！”

冰凉的白酒泼得刘梅和张磊满脸都是，两个人都傻了，愣在原地半天没反应过来。

包厢里还有张磊的爹张志国，也就是机械厂的副厂长，一直坐在旁边没说话。

此时他猛地拍桌子站了起来，脸色铁青：“林川！你发什么疯！”

“我发疯？”

林川一声冷笑，伸手拿起桌上的股权转让协议，看都没看，“唰唰唰”几下撕得粉碎。

碎纸片扔得张志国满头满脸都是。

“你们父子俩合谋坑我们家的厂，真当我林川是傻子？”

The pungent smell of liquor mixed with the smell of cheap tobacco entered his nostrils, and Lin Chuan opened his eyes suddenly.

In front of me is a small restaurant box that is so familiar that it is engraved in my bones.

A promotional poster for the 2000 Spring Festival Gala is posted on the wall. The enamel jar on the table is missing a hole, and a crumpled copy of "Jiangcheng Daily" is spread out next to it.

The date was clearly printed - May 18, 2000.

The two people sitting across from him were smiling in front of him. Their smiles were so hypocritical that it made Lin Chuan's stomach churn.

On the left is his wife Liu Mei, wearing a white washed pink shirt, her hair permed into the popular big waves, but her eyes are full of calculations.

"Linchuan, hurry up and sign. After signing this equity transfer agreement, we will get 100,000 yuan to pay off the debt, and we will be able to live a good life in the future."

On the right is Zhang Lei, his childhood friend, wearing a fake Pierre Cardin suit and a dazzling fake Rolex on his wrist. The hand holding the pen is shaking.

"Yes, Kawako. Your dad is old and the machine factory can no longer operate. If you sell it to my dad, your family can still get 100,000 yuan to pay off the debt. Otherwise, the bank will seal your house."

Equity Transfer Agreement.

May 18, 2000.

The blood all over Lin Chuan's body rushed to the top of his head in an instant, and he clenched his nails so hard that he didn't notice the blood oozing from his palms.

Didn't he freeze to death under a bridge in the winter of 2023?

On this day in his previous life - these two people conspired to force him to drink a pound of liquor, and he muddleheadedly signed an equity transfer agreement in the machinery factory that his father had been running all his life.

The entire factory was sold for only 100,000 yuan.

Later, Zhang Lei and his son took the equity and demolished the property, and lost a total of 80 million yuan.

Zhang Lei lived in a villa, opened a company, became a prominent boss in Jiangcheng, and even married Liu Mei.

And what about the Lin family?

My father was furious to death, my mother cried blindly, and my sister dropped out of school to work to pay off debts, but was hit by a drunk driver on the way home from get off work.

He was so cold under the bridge that he couldn't even curl up his fingers. When he finally closed his eyes, there was only one thought in his mind - it would have been better if he hadn't signed that day.

Unexpectedly, God would give him this opportunity.

"Kawako, what are you doing standing still? Sign it quickly!"

Seeing that he didn't move, Liu Mei reached out to take his hand and press it on the agreement, her tone full of impatience.

Zhang Lei also smiled and coaxed him: "After signing, let's go eat hotpot mutton. I'll treat you. I'll take care of it."

Looking at these two faces, Lin Chuan felt a fishy smell rising from the bottom of his throat.

He suddenly raised his hand, grabbed the remaining half glass of white wine on the table, and threw it over his face!

"I'll sign your mother!"

The cold white wine splashed all over Liu Mei and Zhang Lei's faces. Both of them were stunned and froze in place for a long time without reacting.

Also in the box was Zhang Lei's father, Zhang Zhiguo, the deputy director of the machinery factory, who had been sitting next to him silently.

At this time, he slammed the table and stood up, his face livid: "Lin Chuan! Why are you crazy!"

"Am I crazy?"

Lin Chuan sneered, reached for the equity transfer agreement on the table, and without even looking at it, he tore it into pieces with a few "shuashuashuas".

Shreds of paper were thrown all over Zhang Zhiguo's head and face.

"You father and son conspired to defraud our factory. Do you really think that I, Lin Chuan, am a fool?"
